After attempting to inspect at the address on file on 5 August 2026,, the transporter responded to the phone call that he
"moved away from that part of California December 2025" via voicemail/text message. Registrants shall notify the Deputy
Administrator by certified mail of any change in the address or other change in operations affecting its status as a carrier
within 10 days after making such change, in order to facilitate inspection and ensure compliance with the Animal Welfare
Act.
Correct by: August 5 2026

On April 10, 2025, a 4 year old male golden retriever died of suspected heat stress while being transported from New
Jersey to California. The facility representative reported the dog had been transported in a converted passenger van and
the driver reported they observed the dog pacing and breathing fast. The driver reported they stopped the vehicle and
took the dog out of its travel enclosure. After the dog calmed down it was returned to the enclosure and was then found
dead later by the driver.
The necropsy report summary stated “ suspected stress induced heat stroke”.
Mobile housing facilities for dogs must be sufficiently cooled to provide for their health and well being.
Correct by: August 5th 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representative.
